items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: I said, Mr. Frank, I said, what you want to whip him for?

ctx.x: Who were some of the famous second liners, you know?

I was the famous second liners, yeah. I know that. They taught me the famous second liners right here. Because they didn't have no second liners, no but me. All of them, all of them learned from under me, underneath me. Everybody come, they had to come through me. See, when I, when I come out, I don't care where, I don't care who, who, who, who, what boy it is. Now you, you little boy might be, you little boy might be, be like my little cousin. My, Mr. Hollins. I said, what you say, baby? Where you going,…
Oh, you don't have to. What about, lunch? What about that bell ringing? I wanted to ask you
